content.text: Confirmed: `(no AI provider authorized yet)` is a hardcoded literal string in `runI18nCli`'s output, printed unconditionally regardless of what actually happened — it's not derived from any real provider-auth check. That's why it appears even for the `hu` locale where translation clearly succeeded (52/52 translated).

This is expected/by-design behavior, not a real auth failure.

**Why:** `ui.strings` and `cli.scaffold` are routed through the new `tools/i18n-engine` `i18n translate` CLI (invoked directly from `renderers/web-components` and `packages/scaffold`), whose `translate` command (`runTranslateMessages`/`runTranslateContent` → `mergeAndCount` in [pipeline.ts](tools/i18n-engine/src/pipeline.ts#L115-L128)) is a **deliberate no-op**: it only runs `msgmerge` to keep the `.po` in sync with the `.pot`, and never calls any AI adapter at all. The module docblock says so explicitly:

> "`translate` here is deliberately a no-op beyond keeping the PO catalog current... there is no authorized real AI backend wired up yet"

The `(no AI provider authorized yet)` string is a **hardcoded literal** appended unconditionally in [cli.ts](tools/i18n-engine/src/cli.ts#L158) — it's printed even when translation succeeded (e.g. `hu` shows `52 translated, 0 untranslated` yet still prints the message), so it's not actually reporting live auth state; it's just an honest label that this pipeline never had AI wiring to begin with.

This has nothing to do with your Copilot CLI auth or the `copilot-wrapper.sh` script — that wrapper is only consumed by the **third** command in your log, `docs/scripts/translate-guide-po.ts` (via `DOCS_TRANSLATION_COMMAND`), which is the actual AI-backed pipeline for `docs.guides`. The `hu` locale's 52 translated entries for `cli.scaffold` came from a **pre-existing cached `.po` file**, not from this run — this run just re-merged it against the template and reported the existing state.

If you want `ui.strings`/`cli.scaffold` to get real AI translation like `docs.guides` does, that's an unimplemented feature in `tools/i18n-engine` — not a bug to "fix" by checking Copilot auth.
then we need to implement it.
